definitions.explanation: The quality of remaining calm and collected, especially in stressful or emergency situations. Having presence of mind and not panicking.

examples.japanese: {沈着|ちんちゃく}{冷静|れいせい}
{彼|かれ}は{沈着|ちんちゃく}な{人|ひと}だ。
{緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}でも{沈着|ちんちゃく}に{対応|たいおう}できる{人材|じんざい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need personnel who can respond calmly even in emergencies.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective (also functions as noun). Uses な before nouns: {沈着|ちんちゃく}な{態度|たいど}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {沈着|ちんちゃく}に (calmly, composedly)

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {沈着|ちんちゃく}{冷静|れいせい} (cool and composed) is a common set phrase, often used together for emphasis.

NUANCE: {沈着|ちんちゃく} emphasizes keeping calm under pressure, especially in emergencies or stressful situations. It's a highly positive quality associated with reliable, capable people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沈着|ちんちゃく}{冷静|れいせい} (cool and composed)
- {沈着|ちんちゃく}な{態度|たいど} (composed demeanor)
- {沈着|ちんちゃく}に{対応|たいおう}する (to respond calmly)
- {沈着|ちんちゃく}さを{保|たも}つ (to maintain composure)

RELATED WORDS:
- {冷静|れいせい} (calm, composed - more common)
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}いた (calm, composed - more casual)
- {泰然|たいぜん} (calm, unperturbed - literary)
- {動|どう}じない (unperturbed)
